question: Which of the following states has a marine sanctuary called Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

__
 
• **Odisha has a marine sanctuary called Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary:**

 
 
• It is located in the **Kendrapara district of Odisha.**
 
• The sanctuary is the **world's largest nesting beach for Olive Ridley Turtles. **
 
• The** Government of Orissa **declared the area as** Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary** in **1977 **considering its ecological significance and diverse floral and faunal resources. 
 
• The olive ridley sea turtles migrate from the** pacific ocean** through the **coastal water of Sri Lanka** in the Indian Ocean to the coastal water of Gahirmatha in the north. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a01b1d5b5ef0069a081f382421fe8c4a296cc0eccab2bc17f365833970d57b82.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simlipal National Park, Bhitarkanika National Park, Tikarpada Wildlife Sanctuary, Chilika Wildlife Sanctuary and Sunabeda Wildlife Sanctuary** are some national parks and wildlife sanctuaries of **Odisha**.
